purpose: Map the previously audited 50 functional blocks to vNext; not 50 new skills or deletion tasks.
inspection_boundary: Source paths and family-level mappings inherit the preceding component audit. Path existence is checked now; this is not a fresh line-by-line audit of every source nor new empirical evidence.
review_questions: Which user problem does this serve?
Can it load only on demand?
What evidence supports benefit, and what remains unknown?
Does the host already provide it?
What overhead and loss would removal cause?
How can a real user case test its contribution?
